_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY - no real values. Fill the copy at C:/Users/<you>/.workbuddy/growth-ops/credentials.json directly on this machine. NEVER commit, NEVER paste into chat, GitHub, logs or reports.

github._comment: Optional. If empty, the existing git credential manager token is reused. Prefer a fine-grained PAT limited to the two repos.

deploy._comment: Optional local SSH deploy path for chatgpt5x.com. Prefer GitHub Actions secrets instead.

baidu_tongji._comment: tongji.baidu.com -> 管理 -> 其它设置 -> 数据导出服务, obtain API Key + Secret Key. Run `python ops/data_platform.py auth-url baidu`, authorize in the browser, then `exchange baidu <code>`. Fields below marked AUTO are maintained by the refresh flow.
baidu_tongji._auto_fields: access_token / refresh_token / expires_at / token_fingerprint are written automatically by exchange + refresh. Do not paste them into chat.
baidu_tongji._site_ids_hint: Site IDs are numeric. Find them in tongji.baidu.com website list, or call site/getSiteList after the token is valid. Both sites must be present.

ga4._comment: GCP service account JSON (Viewer on GA4 property; Analytics Data API enabled). Store the JSON in ~/.workbuddy/growth-ops/keys/ and put its absolute path here - never its contents.
ga4._coverage_note: Measured fact: chatgpt5x.com has GA4 G-H41YCVV2ZX; zhibeimao.com has NO GA4 tag (Baidu Tongji only). Leave zhibeimao empty and it stays UNKNOWN - do not fabricate a property.

gsc._comment: Reuses ga4.service_account_json_path. Enable Search Console API and add the service account client_email as Restricted User on BOTH properties (最小权限).

bing_webmaster._comment: https://www.bing.com/webmasters/apikeys -> Generate API Key. One read-only key covers all verified sites; both domains must be verified in the same WMT account.

baidu_ziyuan._comment: ziyuan.baidu.com -> 普通收录 -> API提交 -> token. Push-only. This platform has NO public traffic/index/keyword read API; those metrics stay UNKNOWN unless exported manually from the console.

vercel._comment: Optional, read-only deployments token. Git push -> Vercel already deploys without this.
